items.title: Panes never get squeezed
items.text: A pane is never narrower or shorter than 300pt. When a row can't fit side by side, the panes that don't fit fold into slim strips at the edge, each showing its title. Click a strip, or focus its pane any other way, and it slides into view.

items.title: Collapse by dragging
items.text: Drag a divider past a pane's minimum and the outermost pane on that side folds into a strip while you're still dragging. Drag back and it comes back out. You can also drag a strip to move its pane, swapping it with a visible pane.

items.title: No resize flicker on slides
items.text: Panes slide in and out without being resized frame by frame, so a TUI running in one doesn't redraw during the animation.

items.title: An enrolled Mac stays online
items.text: If this Mac is enrolled as a remote machine on your account, Ghoztty now keeps its relay agent running, so the Mac shows up as online in every machine chooser. Signing out stops it.

items.title: Background windows open at the right size
items.text: Windows opened by `ghoztty +new-window` without `--focus` now use the same size as a window you open by hand.

items.title: Idle Claude panes stay idle
items.text: A Claude Code pane no longer switches to "question" a minute after it finishes. Only an actual question or permission prompt marks it that way.

items.title: No beep in viewer panes
items.text: Pressing Return, a letter, or an arrow key that a viewer page doesn't use no longer makes the system beep.
